questions.question: God listened to His people speak, and a scroll of remembrance was written before Him. Who was the scroll about?

answers.text: Those who feared the LORD and honored His name
Those who said serving God was useless
Those who served as priests in the temple

questions.question: God said a day is coming, burning like a furnace. Who will be like stubble set ablaze on that day?

answers.text: Those who fear the LORD's name

questions.question: God promised those who fear His name that something would rise with healing in its wings. What is it?
Which prophet did God say He would send before the great and awesome Day of the LORD?
